journal_entries.text: First entry. Dr. Ortiz wants me to write when the worry spiral starts. It started at 6am about a meeting that isn't until Thursday.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Anticipatory worry days ahead of a work event.

journal_entries.text: I rewrote the same email four times. I know it's the ADHD plus the anxiety feeding each other but knowing doesn't stop it.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Perfectionism loop around a work email; insight without relief.

journal_entries.text: Tried the 10-minute worry window. Weird to schedule worrying but I actually stopped at the timer.
journal_entries.ai_summary: First use of scheduled worry time with success.

journal_entries.text: Ran before work three times. Mornings are less jittery when I do. The med timer on my watch is helping.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Exercise and medication routine reducing morning anxiety.

journal_entries.text: Best week in a while. Finished the planning doc a day early. Nobody died.
Ran into my old manager at the coffee place and didn't freeze. Said something normal. Progress.
Launch got pulled in by two weeks. I am back to 4am wakeups and chest tightness. Skipped the run all week.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Acute work stressor; sleep disruption and lapsed exercise.

journal_entries.text: Missed session because of a release call. Took a double dose of coffee instead of eating. Not great.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Missed therapy; poor self-care during crunch.

journal_entries.text: Shipped. Slept 9 hours. Then spent the whole weekend convinced something would break. Nothing did.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Post-launch relief with lingering catastrophic worry.

journal_entries.text: Back to running. Did the thought record on the 'they'll find out I'm a fraud' thought. Evidence against was long.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Resumed exercise; cognitive restructuring applied to imposter thought.

journal_entries.text: Noticed I forgot meds two days and the fog was obvious. Set a second alarm. Mood fine though.
Presented to leadership. Heart rate on the watch was 110 but I got through it and it was fine. Dr. Ortiz says that's the whole point.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Exposure to feared presentation completed successfully.

voice_notes.transcript: Okay. Uh, it's Saturday and I've been thinking about Monday since I woke up. That's the thing I'm supposed to notice. Noticed.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Anticipatory anxiety about the work week.

voice_notes.transcript: Ran this morning. Legs hurt, brain quiet for like twenty minutes. Worth it.
Had a good week. I keep waiting for the catch. That's probably a thing to bring up.
It's 4am again. Launch stuff. I'm not going to get back to sleep so I'm just saying it out loud.
Launch is done. I feel like I ran a marathon and I'm angry at myself for how much it took out of me.
Presentation went fine. Hands shook but nobody noticed, or they didn't care. Either way.
